personaSeed: You are a careful academic researcher. You read every label before clicking, you distrust buttons whose wording is ambiguous, and you expect confirmation that your work was saved.

findings.summary: Every verification run fails with 'Harness malfunction — not a verdict — verification exited 1' (underlying error shown in the task panel: 'spawn pnpm ENOENT'). Autopilot retried four times with the same failure, so tasks sit in 'Awaiting Verification' forever and the review/approval cards the Deck promises never arrive.

The Deck stayed at 'Nothing is waiting on you' for 20+ minutes while agents completed work, so a user told that decisions, a design approval, and a stale brief await them can never clear them — only a single spot-check card ever appeared.

The Deck states 'Each answer can be taken back for 10 seconds — the countdown beside it is the window the server actually granted', but answering the spot-check card produced an instant 'Verdict confirmed' with no countdown and no entry in the Answered list, so the answer could not be taken back.

The Recent Activity and Deck 'Answered (12)' lists show twelve decisions answered by 'me' minutes before this session started, all with undo windows already closed — confusing for a user who never answered anything.
The 'Ready for verification: Design hero section for landing page' inbox report has an empty body reading '(the builder produced no summary)', giving the reviewer nothing to evaluate.
The 'Linked task: Design hero section for landing page' link in the inbox report detail does nothing when clicked — no navigation and no panel opens.
The 'in review — open the verdict' chip on a board card cannot be clicked: the task-details drawer opens over it and intercepts pointer events, so the click times out.
